title: IndigoReach - Giving Wings to Fly
summary: We conducted a session on the IndiGoReach – Giving Wings to Fly (GWF) Programme at S.S. College, Nerul.
description:
We conducted a session on the IndiGoReach – Giving Wings to Fly (GWF) Programme at S.S. College, Nerul. The session was conducted successfully, with 29 students actively participating.

Out of the 29 participants, 22 students expressed their interest in the GWF Programme. The session provided students with detailed information about the programme, its objectives, eligibility criteria, and opportunities available to them.

Our team encouraged the students to participate and explore the opportunities offered through the GWF Programme. They also helped create a positive and engaging environment for the students.

Overall, the session was very well received, and we received a positive response from the students.
location: S S College, Seawoods, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
